Relax, Reclaim, & Revel

Ready to give your summer lifestyle the ultimate upgrade? Imagine stepping into a pool that stays perpetually pristine, with water so crystal-clear and inviting, it’s like having a private resort concierge at your service! Choosing professional weekly maintenance isn't just a convenience; it's your chance to completely liberate your swimming experience from the burden of chores. Think perfectly balanced chemistry, immaculate surfaces, and a flawless aesthetic that ensures every single dip feels like a luxurious, worry-free escape. This is your opportunity to transform pool ownership from a hidden job into a pure indulgence, creating the perfect backdrop for spontaneous swims and unforgettable weekend memories. Let’s make your effortless backyard oasis the envy of the neighborhood!
How Much Does Weekly Pool Maintenance Cost In Kitchener-Waterloo? In the Kitchener-Waterloo area, professional weekly pool service generally ranges from $120 to $150 per visit. At Hipel Pools, we provide transparent, flat-rate pricing for our Boutique and Estate Plan, ensuring you know exactly what to budget for a pristine pool all season long without any hidden "convenience" fees.

 
How Do I Choose Between the one-visit and two-visit weekly maintenance plans?

The choice depends on your lifestyle and pool usage. Our Boutique Plan (1x weekly) is ideal for homeowners who don’t mind a quick 5-minute task like emptying a skimmer basket mid-week. However, for those with high-traffic pools, heavy surrounding foliage, or a desire for a 100% "hands-off" experience, our Estate Plan (2x weekly) ensures your pool is better prepared when your ready to use it.

 
Are Pool Chemicals Included In The Weekly Service Price?

To ensure the highest water quality, our service fee covers the professional labour of testing, balancing, and cleaning your pool. Because every pool in the Kitchener-Waterloo has unique demands based on its size, sun exposure, environment and use, chemicals used are billed based on exact consumption. This ensures you only pay for exactly what your pool needs to stay sparkling and safe.
Do you offer specialized care for saltwater pools and cartridge filters?

Yes. We are experts in both traditional chlorine and modern saltwater systems. While our weekly plans cover all standard skimming and chemistry, we also offer specialized deep-cleaning for Salt Cells and Cartridge Filters as needed. These services are vital for equipment longevity and are available as a seamless add-on to your regular maintenance schedule.

 

 
Do I need to be home for my weekly maintenance visits?

Not at all. Our service is designed to be as unobtrusive as it is thorough. Most of our Kitchener-Waterloo clients prefer to go about their day while we handle the work. As long as our team has clear access to your backyard and pool equipment, we will perform your maintenance discreetly and professionally. You’ll simply return home to a pristine pool, with a digital service report waiting in your inbox to let you know exactly what was performed.
What happens if there is inclement weather on my scheduled service day?

We evaluate the weather forecasts on a day-by-day basis to ensure the safety of our technicians and the best results for your pool. Should a severe storm or heavy rain prevent us from providing a thorough service, we will contact you promptly to provide an update. In these cases, we prioritize your pool’s health by rescheduling your visit for the next available clear window, typically within a day or two of your original appointment, to ensure your water remains pristine.
